record.field: Find records of a model. Returns rows plus total/offset/has_more/next_offset: pass next_offset as offset while has_more is true to page. Respects the user's own access rights.

field.name: schema

record.field: Read one record's fields by model and id. Pass res_ids (up to 10) to read several at once; missing ids come back in a missing list instead of failing the batch.

field.name: schema

record.field: Return an action that opens a list/kanban/form view for the user's client.
Summarize the chatter of a record for a reader who knows nothing.
Translate a text to a target language, keeping tone and names.
Draft a reply to a chatter message. Never sends.
Suggest concrete next actions for a record, given its data and chatter.

Prepare a record as a DRAFT the user reviews and confirms. Never posts. Send only fields the user or a fetched page actually stated — never invent SKUs, barcodes, prices, costs or references; omit unknown fields instead of filling them.

field.name: schema

record.field: Queue an internal note on a record; the user confirms before it is posted.
Queue an activity on a record; the user confirms.

Confirm a draft or sent quotation (sale.order). Queues an approval card showing partner and total; only runs when the user approves. Chain: pass after {kind, model} plus bind {field: created} and approving the earlier card fills the order in.
Validate (post) a draft invoice or bill (account.move). Queues an approval card showing partner and total; only runs when the user approves.
Duplicate a record (quotation, invoice, task...). The copy restarts as a draft; sequences and posting data never carry over. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.

Read one2many lines of a record: order_line on a sale order, invoice_line_ids on a bill, move_ids on a picking. Returns rows plus count/offset/has_more/next_offset: pass next_offset as offset while has_more is true to page. Capped at 25 rows.

field.name: schema

record.field: Delete a record. Confirm-only and never automatic: queues an approval card stating the record, and only runs when the user approves. Deletion cannot be undone.

Run a public business button on a record: action_confirm, action_post, button_validate and similar. Never automatic and never private methods, sudo, or raw create/write/unlink. Queues an approval card naming method, record and arguments. Chain: pass after {kind, model} plus bind {field: created} and approving the earlier card fills this one in.

field.name: schema

record.field: Count and sum records grouped by a field: sales by month, tickets by priority. Aggregate only numeric fields (amount_total, residual); names and states are group-bys, never sums. Read-only, max 25 groups.

List a model's fields with type, label, required and options. Read-only introspection so field names are looked up, never guessed. Pass query (substring matched against names AND labels) or fields (exact names) to search instead of dumping all 150+ fields of a big model.

field.name: schema

record.field: Read a business method's parameter names and docs without running it — or list a model's callable methods when method is omitted. Read-only self-repair: when a method call fails, inspect first, then re-queue with corrected arguments instead of guessing again. Never executes anything.

field.name: schema

record.field: Ask the user a clarifying question with clickable options instead of guessing when the request is ambiguous. One focused question, 1 to 6 concrete options; the answer arrives as the next message and the turn resumes. Options accept plain strings or {label, description} objects; header is an optional short label.

field.name: schema
example
field.eval: {"question": "Which customer did you mean?", "options": ["Acme Corp", {"label": "Acme Ltd", "description": "The Lyon subsidiary"}]}

record.field: List files attached to a record (name, type, size) so scans can be found for digitizing. Read-only; file contents stay out.

Set one simple field (text, number, date, yes/no, choice, or linked record) on a record. Queues an approval card showing old and new values; only writes when the user approves. Chain: pass after {kind, model} plus bind {field: created} and approving the earlier card fills the record in.

Read a vendor-bill scan (PDF or image attachment) and propose a draft bill. Returns an approval card when partner and totals check out, otherwise a follow-up question (ambiguous partner, totals mismatch). Never posts.

Fetch a public URL and return its readable text plus its outgoing links (no private hosts). Research by fetching: start at an index like https://www.odoo.com/documentation/ and follow the returned links.

Search the agent knowledge: skills (procedures to follow), saved facts, wiki concepts and indexed document passages. Returns concept codes you can then read with read_knowledge, and source passages with their document.

Read a file attached to a record into the turn: text files and text-layer PDFs come back as text; scans and images come back as metadata (bills go through digitize_bill). The file must sit on a record the agent may see.
Cancel an invoice or bill (account.move). Refuses paid or locked entries with the credit-note route instead. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.
Cancel a draft or sent quotation (sale.order). Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.
Confirm a draft request for quotation into a purchase order. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.
Validate a ready delivery (stock.picking in Ready state). Refuses anything not reserved yet and says what is missing. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.

Create the draft invoice for a confirmed sale order. Refuses unconfirmed orders. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves. Chain: pass after {kind, model} plus bind {field: created} and approving the earlier card fills the order in.

Add one product line with a positive quantity to a draft or sent order. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves. Chain: pass after {kind, model} plus bind {"values.order_id": "created"} and approving the earlier card fills the order in.

Register a payment against a posted invoice through the payment wizard (never a manual journal entry). Amount defaults to the open balance and is capped at it. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves. Chain: pass after {kind, model} plus bind {field: created} and approving the earlier card fills the invoice in.

field.name: schema

record.field: Reconcile an invoice with its payment move(s) on reconcilable accounts only. Name the payment moves explicitly. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.
Create a credit note reversing a posted invoice through the reversal wizard (never a manual negative invoice). Only posted invoices qualify. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.
Move a helpdesk ticket into its closing stage with an optional closing note. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.
Log hours (0 to 24) on a project task with an optional date word like today or yesterday. Queues an approval card; only runs when the user approves.
Load one knowledge concept (a skill, a fact, a procedure) by its code. The system prompt lists only the names; call this to get the body, then follow it exactly.

field.name: schema

record.field: Propose a durable piece of knowledge (a fact, a procedure, a reference). It is saved as a DRAFT and only counts once a human accepts it, so nothing you write becomes truth on its own. Never store credentials.

field.name: schema
example
field.eval: {"name": "Acme Corp is a res.partner with customer_rank 1", "kind": "memory", "description": "How to recognise our key customers", "body": "Acme Corp lives on res.partner with customer_rank > 0. There is no customer flag."}

record.field: List the saved multi-step flows you may run, with a one-line description of each.

field.name: schema

record.field: Run a saved multi-step flow. Steps that write queue a confirmation card instead of changing anything - approve the card, then run the flow again to continue.

field.name: schema

record.field: Build a validated Odoo domain from structured conditions. Say what you want ("customers that are overdue, for company Acme") and the server returns the domain to pass to search_records or count_records. Use this instead of hand-writing domain triplets: a hand-written domain with a wrong operator or a nested shape is the most common reason a search fails.

field.name: schema

record.field: List the models you are allowed to read and write, with their labels. Use it when you do not know the exact model name, or to check that a model exists before you search it. Returns nothing for a model you may not touch, rather than a refusal later.

field.name: schema

record.field: Check a write before making it

Dry-run a create or a write: nothing is written and nothing is queued. You get back the unknown fields, the readonly fields, the required fields you are missing, and the current value of every field you want to change. Use it before queueing a write so the card you ask the user to approve is one that will actually apply.

field.name: schema

record.field: Write several fields on ONE record in one card: name, price, reference, category, description - all in a single approval. Use it instead of chaining several set_field calls, which meant several cards and a half-updated record if the user approved only some of them. The card shows every field with its old and new value, and Undo restores all of them together.

field.name: schema

record.field: Diagnose what the user may touch

Diagnose whether the user may read or write a model or a record, and why. Returns per-operation access, the access rows that apply to this user, the effective rule domain, and for one record whether THAT row may be read and written. Use it when a read or write is refused (AccessError) instead of guessing: the refusal names no cause, this tool does. Also checks named fields for group gating and readonly before a card is queued.

field.name: schema

record.field: Read the deployment's own custom Odoo code (models, fields, methods) without importing or running it. Returns the catalogue of models found, or the full knowledge-shaped body for the models you name. Use it when the question is about custom models or fields the seeds do not cover. Propose what you learn with write_knowledge - the human review gate still applies.

field.name: schema

record.field: Save a plan as a reusable flow

Save the current plan as a reusable flow so next time it is one call instead of a whole conversation. The steps are validated with the flow rules BEFORE anything is queued: a broken flow comes back as problems to fix, never as a card. A valid one queues a normal create card; approving it registers the flow. Use it when you just solved something the user will ask for again.

field.name: schema

record.field: Revise a saved flow from chat: pass the flow name plus the full corrected nodes+edges (+trigger). Validated BEFORE anything is queued; the change queues an approval card, nothing writes inline. Use it when the user says change/fix/add a step to a flow.

field.name: schema

record.field: Return a flow's portable JSON definition so you can show, copy or audit it in chat. Read-only.
Build a flow from pasted JSON — Nova-native or n8n workflow JSON (nodes+connections). Same graph runs in Odoo; unknown n8n nodes import flagged. Validated BEFORE anything queues.
Show recent flow runs: status, trigger, duration, error. Use it when the user asks what ran, what failed, or for the last run of a flow.
